name: The Editor's Pass
summary: Your metrics digest as a galley proof: an unseen copy editor marks the one wrong figure and a human initials the page.
look: Warm near-white galley paper with numbered lines, wide margins and Instrument Serif rows. Exact coral proof marks (caret, squiggle, circled figure, leader line to a mono margin query) and teal ticks; a double-ruled OK TO SHIP stamp closes it.

components.name: Galley slip
components.role: line-numbered metrics digest; the stage for every beat

components.name: Squiggle underline
components.role: spell-check wave under the suspect figure

components.name: Circled figure + leader line
components.role: ties the anomaly value to the margin

components.name: Margin query
components.role: mono annotation carrying the anomaly text

components.name: Proof glyphs
components.role: insert caret, delete pigtail and teal tick as exact vectors

components.name: Initials box + OK TO SHIP stamp

motion.name: Stroke draw-on
motion.how: stroke-dashoffset 0.5–0.7 s power2.inOut, each mark starting on a downbeat (0.5 s grid at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Squiggle crawl
motion.how: wave path translateX loop, 1 s per cycle (two beats), linear

motion.name: Leader-line callout
motion.how: line draws 0.35 s power3.out, then the margin note types in with steps(18) across one bar

story: Hook: a galley of 38 dashboards nobody has read, a grey '?' in the margin. Reveal: '38 dashboards, read by hand' is struck out and a coral insert caret drops 'Acme Pulse' into the line on the drop. Proof: teal ticks run down the rows, Checkout conversion gets a squiggle and a circle, the margin query reads '−18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231', and the human taps Roll back and initials the box. CTA: clean page, 'You ship. Pulse watches.', OK TO SHIP stamp, Start free.
adapt: Set your own report, invoice, config file or changelog as the galley and turn your product's finding into the margin query; the human action becomes the initials box.

references.note: an ad that makes spotting errors the whole idea
simplified correction UI made readable for commercials

fit.risk: Can drift toward the hand-drawn marker look; keep every mark typographic and exact.
